name: Mukuro
source:
Side character of episode 2
One of [url=/c92663]Mihoshi[/url]'s close friends from her time working for the cult.
A man who shares many connections with the cult. Wearing an eyepatch and having a skeleton-like body, he gives other people the first impression of being a bad guy.
